items.reason: A gentle cleanser with no actives keeps young skin feeling clean without stripping it.
A light ceramide moisturizer supports comfortable, balanced-looking skin.
A mineral SPF 50 is the one product that suits young skin for daily outdoor protection.

response.routine_note: Cleanse and moisturize morning and night, then add sunscreen in the morning; I've left out retinol, vitamin C and the 30% peel because they aren't suitable for someone under 13, however popular they are online. If you have skin worries, please talk with a parent or guardian and ask a pediatrician or dermatologist.
